question: The geostrophic flow conditions occur when the pressure gradient force is balanced by __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Coriolis force.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Geostrophic motion is the motion in which fluid flow in a direction parallel to lines of equal pressure
